svg.title: Control Studio's two PI loops on the coupled vessels
svg.desc: With Control Studio's design, Kp 6.75 and Ki 1.73 for each vessel, a 2 degree step of vessel 1's setpoint alone moves heater 1 to 88.85 percent on the first update while heater 2 stays at 75 percent; the heat crossing the wall lifts the unchanged vessel 2 by 0.269 degrees at 7.6 seconds, outside 0.2 degrees, and the heaters end at 92.98 and 67.02 percent. A 10 kilowatt load on vessel 1 lowers it to 34.745 degrees and vessel 2 by 0.049 degrees.
svg.text: Control Studio's two PI loops on the coupled vessels
Control Studio's validation trials of this project · Kp 6.75 %/°C, Ki 1.73 %/(°C·s) per vessel · numbers answer the predictions
